definitions.explanation: Raising water to a higher place, typically with a pump. Also refers to pumped-storage hydroelectricity, in which water is pumped uphill to store energy.

examples.japanese: ⟦ポンプ→ポンプ：11594_ponpu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{揚水|ようすい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: to pump water up with a pump.

examples.japanese: ⟦{田|た}んぼ→田んぼ：00402_tanbo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{揚水|ようすい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: to pump water up to the rice paddies.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{発電所|はつでんしょ}→発電所：15991_hatsudensho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{夜間|やかん}→夜間：04133_yakan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{揚水|ようすい}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ためる。
examples.english: This power station pumps water up at night to store electricity.

notes:
Raising water to a higher place, typically with a pump. Also names pumped-storage power generation, where water is pumped uphill during off-peak hours to be released later.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {揚水|ようすい}⟦ポンプ→ポンプ：11594_ponpu⟧: water-lifting pump
- {揚水|ようすい}⟦{発電|はつでん}→発電：04312_hatsuden⟧: pumped-storage power generation
- ⟦{田|た}→田：03380_ta⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{揚水|ようすい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to pump water to the fields

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{用水|ようすい}→用水：29725_yousui⟧: water for irrigation or general use — same reading, different kanji
